title: Data Broker & Collection Risk Calculator | Privacy Assessment
metaDescription: Calculate your data broker exposure risk. Assess how much personal data is being collected and sold by data brokers with actionable protection steps.
description: Evaluate your exposure to data brokers and assess how much of your personal information is being collected, sold, and profited from. Get a personalized risk score and actionable steps to protect your privacy from data collection companies.

inputs.label: Number of social media accounts
inputs.helpText: Include Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.

inputs.label: Online shopping frequency
inputs.helpText: How often you make purchases online

inputs.label: Public records exposure
inputs.helpText: Property ownership, voting records, business registrations

inputs.label: Loyalty programs enrolled
inputs.helpText: Store cards, airline miles, rewards programs

inputs.label: Have you opted out of data brokers?
inputs.helpText: Whether you've requested removal from data broker sites

inputs.label: Privacy settings awareness
inputs.helpText: How often you review and adjust privacy settings

outputFields.label: Data Collection Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall risk level for data broker collection and selling (0-100)

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Categorized risk level based on your data exposure

outputFields.label: Estimated Brokers with Your Data
outputFields.description: Approximate number of data brokers likely to have your information

outputFields.label: Current Protection Level
outputFields.description: How well you're currently protecting yourself from data collection

formula: let socialScore = 0; switch(inputs.socialMediaAccounts) { case '0': socialScore = 0; break; case '1-2': socialScore = 15; break; case '3-5': socialScore = 30; break; case '6-10': socialScore = 50; break; case '10+': socialScore = 70; break; } let shoppingScore = 0; switch(inputs.onlineShoppingFrequency) { case 'never': shoppingScore = 0; break; case 'monthly': shoppingScore = 10; break; case 'weekly': shoppingScore = 20; break; case 'daily': shoppingScore = 35; break; } let publicScore = 0; switch(inputs.publicRecordsExposure) { case 'low': publicScore = 10; break; case 'moderate': publicScore = 25; break; case 'high': publicScore = 40; break; } let loyaltyScore = Math.min(inputs.loyaltyPrograms * 2, 30); let emailScore = 0; switch(inputs.emailSubscriptions) { case 'few': emailScore = 5; break; case 'some': emailScore = 15; break; case 'many': emailScore = 25; break; case 'unknown': emailScore = 20; break; } let baseRisk = socialScore + shoppingScore + publicScore + loyaltyScore + emailScore; let protectionBonus = 0; switch(inputs.dataOptOuts) { case 'no': protectionBonus = 0; break; case 'some': protectionBonus = -15; break; case 'many': protectionBonus = -30; break; } switch(inputs.privacySettings) { case 'none': protectionBonus += 10; break; case 'basic': protectionBonus += 0; break; case 'advanced': protectionBonus -= 10; break; } let riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, baseRisk + protectionBonus)); let riskLevel = ''; if(riskScore <= 25) riskLevel = 'Low'; else if(riskScore <= 50) riskLevel = 'Moderate'; else if(riskScore <= 75) riskLevel = 'High'; else riskLevel = 'Very High'; let estimatedBrokers = Math.round((riskScore / 100) * 400 + 50); let protectionScore = Math.max(0, 100 - riskScore); return { riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskLevel: riskLevel, estimatedBrokers: estimatedBrokers, protectionScore: Math.round(protectionScore) };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your data broker exposure based on common data collection sources including social media presence, online shopping habits, public records, loyalty programs, and current privacy protection measures. The risk score reflects how much personal data is likely being collected and sold by data brokers.
tips: Opt out of major data brokers like Whitepages, Spokeo, and BeenVerified regularly
Use Incognito Browser to prevent tracking while browsing and shopping online
Review and tighten privacy settings on all social media accounts
Limit loyalty program enrollments to essential ones only
Use separate email addresses for shopping and subscriptions
Consider using privacy-focused search engines instead of Google
Regularly audit and unsubscribe from marketing emails
Check if your information appears in data broker searches and request removal

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: You have minimal data broker exposure. Continue current privacy practices and stay vigilant about new data collection sources.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Your data is likely held by many brokers but you have some protection. Focus on opting out of major data brokers and improving privacy settings.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant data broker exposure. Urgent action needed to opt out of brokers, reduce data sharing, and implement stronger privacy measures.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum data broker exposure. Your information is widely available for sale. Immediately begin systematic opt-out process and overhaul privacy practices.
